chunks: Remember, when the infidels contrived to make you a prisoner or to murder or expel you, they plotted, but God also planned; and God's plan is the best.

key_terms.لِيُثْبِتُوكَ: To make you a prisoner/detain you

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Al-Makirun' mean in the context of God's plan against the disbelievers?
ai.summary: This verse (8:30) specifically references the strategic encirclement of the Prophet in Mecca prior to the Hijrah, where the Quraysh conspired to immobilize him in his home to prevent escape. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi in *Majma' al-Bayan*, emphasize the linguistic nuance of 'Yamkuruna' (they plot) versus 'Yamkuru Allahu' (God plots) to illustrate the transition from human political maneuvering to divine sovereign will, affirming that God's plan ultimately supersedes all earthly schemes.
